dct_description_sm: This project had four distinct tasks, all of which responded to different Northwest Territory (NWT) needs. Firstly, the Government of the Northwest Territories (GNWT) had limited capacity to manage and undertake adaptation projects. Secondly, there was no central internet source for adaptation information in the Northwest Territories. Thirdly, to prioritize further permafrost mapping in NWT communities, it was necessary to identify where permafrost mapping had been completed, at what scale, using what methodology and how recently. Fourthly, unlike the provinces, the NWT did not have a resource level digital elevation model, a fundamental tool for adaptation planning and required for downscaling climate data as well as for completing various modeling and mapping tasks.
